name: expo-android
description: Drive an Android emulator or device over ADB: inspect the UI, tap elements by text, assert state, and install Expo Go.

adb_path.title: ADB path
adb_path.description: Path to the adb binary. Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH, ANDROID_HOME, or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT.

adb_serial.title: Device serial
adb_serial.description: Device or emulator serial to target. Leave empty to use the only connected device.
